centerRule: correctedCenterMs = old targetMs - frozen same-song opposite-fold E5 correctionMs
candidateRule: Select the nearest exported full peak within correctedCenterMs +/-10 ms; ties by smaller absolute distance then smaller peak time
candidateAbsoluteRule: Candidate is the selected peak absolute time directly; do not subtract correctionMs again and do not shift the old selected peak
missingRule: No full peak inside the corrected window remains missing and is incorrect for audible recall
calibrationPolicy: Reuse E5 correction exactly; no new calibration, same-fold labels, oracle center, second correction or target-specific override
primaryMetric: Population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate using absolute candidate time, missing candidates incorrect
guardrails: sample-044 audible correct rate at least 80%

hypotheses.H1: E13 improves weighted audible +/-5 ms correct rate over E10
hypotheses.H2: E13 has positive net fixed weight, preserves sample-044 at least 80%, and does not increase no-clear output rate
hypotheses.H3: Every candidate can be reconstructed from old target, frozen opposite-fold E5 correction and exported full peaks without current-object labels

testPolicy: Exactly one corrected-center and +/-10 ms nearest-full-peak rule; no window/threshold sweep, DDC fallback, per-song gate, new inference or post-hoc override
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
